name: World of Warcraft
description: Track a Retail character’s stats and real pixel avatar via Raider.IO, or fresher data from Blizzard’s official API.
author: FiestaBoard Team

realm.title: Realm
realm.description: Realm name or slug, such as argent-dawn. Copy the slug from your Raider.IO or Armory profile URL; Russian, Korean and Taiwanese realms must use the slug.

data_source.title: Data source
data_source.description: Blizzard updates when the character logs out; Raider.IO can lag hours or days behind.
enumNames: Automatic: Blizzard when credentials are set, otherwise Raider.IO

client_id.title: Battle.net client ID
client_id.description: At develop.battle.net → API Access → Create Client: any unique name, redirect URL https://fiestaboard.app/auth/oauth/redirect (unused), tick “I do not have a service URL”. Copy the client ID here.

client_secret.title: Battle.net client secret
client_secret.description: From the same client. It stays on this board and is only sent to Blizzard. Never share it; reset it at develop.battle.net if exposed.

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: Neither source is live game telemetry: Blizzard updates on logout, Raider.IO on its own crawl.

avatar_width.title: Avatar pixel width
avatar_width.description: Source image resolution (1–128). The page canvas area controls where and how large it appears. Use 64 × 64 for a full Pixoo display. Rectangles crop the portrait without stretching.

avatar_height.title: Avatar pixel height
avatar_height.description: Source image resolution (1–128). The page canvas area controls where and how large it appears. Use 64 × 64 for a full Pixoo display. Rectangles crop the portrait without stretching.

ui:sections.title: Fresher data from Blizzard (optional)
ui:sections.description: Raider.IO works with no setup but can lag hours or days. Blizzard updates when you log out. To use it, create your own free Battle.net API client at develop.battle.net (about two minutes, nothing to apply for) and paste its ID and secret below. Full guide: github.com/Fiestaboard/fiestaboard-plugin--wow

item_level.description: Equipped item level; null when unavailable

season.description: Current Mythic+ season (Raider.IO slug or Blizzard season ID)

mythic_score.description: Overall current-season Mythic+ score (Raider.IO score or Blizzard rating); null when unavailable

healer_score.description: Current-season healer score (Raider.IO only); null when unavailable

weekly_highest_key.description: Highest completed key this week, including untimed runs

weekly_key_display.description: Highest completed key formatted as +N, or --

source.description: Data provider name: Raider.IO or Blizzard

source_short.description: Short provider label: RIO or BNET

profile_url.description: Raider.IO or Blizzard Armory character profile link

source_updated_at.description: Raider.IO crawl time, or the character’s last logout for Blizzard

source_age_days.description: Age of the source snapshot in days; null if unknown

fetched_at.description: Timestamp of our last successful fetch, not the source update time

stale.description: True when showing a saved snapshot after a failed refresh

status.description: OK, OLD DATA (source older than seven days; for Blizzard, no logout in seven days), or STALE (refresh failed)

avatar_canvas.description: Real Blizzard character portrait as pixel canvas content; null until an image is available. Set a page canvas source to {{wow.avatar_canvas}}.

avatar_status.description: OK, STALE (last good portrait), or UNAVAILABLE

avatar_url.description: Blizzard image URL for the displayed portrait, or empty when unavailable

screenshots.alt: World of Warcraft character dashboard with an AI art canvas beside API-sourced stats
